title: 大阪杯の後に・眼光炯々

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki has an immensely satisfying race! Her obsession sets her fighting spirit ablaze, and she can feel the blaze fierce and water still perfectly balanced within her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That said, she hasn't quite managed to steal the audience's hearts. While there are some who acknowledge her performance, the majority are wishing Oguri Cap was there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki is convinced that she has to defeat Oguri Cap. She also believes she has what it takes to best her now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We decide to make the Yasuda Kinen our next goal. There, she'll face off against Oguri Cap.
